name: Hi Robot
summary: Hi Robot places a high-level VLM reasoner above a pi-0 low-level policy. The reasoner decomposes complex prompts and real-time human feedback ('no, use the other one', 'that is not trash') into atomic language commands the VLA executes. Both levels are trained on robot data rather than hand-scripted, letting the system handle open-ended instructions and mid-execution corrections.
innovation: Trains the high-level reasoner on robot-grounded data instead of using an off-the-shelf LLM planner.
Handles real-time verbal interruption and correction during execution.
matters: Made the System-1 / System-2 split concrete and learnable for manipulation.
limits: Closed; latency between levels constrains how fast corrections take effect.
lineage: SayCan's hierarchical decomposition with both levels learned and grounded in robot data.
